mechanism: Bumetanide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities increase cyclosporine nephrotoxicity and reduce renal clearance, while cyclosporine may reduce bumetanide efficacy and increase ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cyclosporine levels closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretics or dose adjustments based on clinical response and lab parameters.
